notes.title: New VR Game on Early Access
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

I'm proud to announce the release of [b]Super VR Trainer[/b] on Early Access so everyone of you can participate on the development of the various games it includes.

Also, to celebrate the release, we've included a [b]new game[/b]: Hover Board. How long can you survive surfing this futuristic landscape? Let's find out!

So, welcome to Early Access! We are eager to get your feedback!

notes.title: Permanent price drop and new VR game!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

Just a quick note to let you know that I've permanently dropped Soccertron price. Thanks everyone who purchased it full price along the years, but the time has come for a price drop.

On other news, I'm publishing a new VR game: [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/509070]Super VR Trainer[/url]. It's a collection of different mechanics for... VR. It's coming soon to Early Access and we are eager to get feedback so we can release a great game.

If you want to see some reactions to [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/509070]Super VR Trainer[/url], [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=2GESG4CJZrQ]check this video out![/url]

Thanks!

notes.title: New update: v. 2016041102
notes.notes:
Mainly improved visuals, but also a few minor tweaks and bug fixes:
[list]
[*] Shiny New graphics for the players.
[*] Renewed animations, for the new graphics.
[*] Show tips before starting a game.
[*] Exiting a match will take you to the game selection scene instead of the main menu.
[*] New background for the game and controller selection screen.
[*] Performance improvements
[*] Some cleanup, so the game has a smaller size now
[*] New command line option: "+allowtimecontrol". I'll let you guess what's the use of it...
[/list]
I hope you enjoy the player's new graphics, although I have to admit that I'll miss the old ones a bit :)

By the way, the new trailer music is by my friend [url=http://sergeeo.gameaudio.es/]Sergeeo[/url]

notes.title: A shiny new release!
notes.notes:
After a few months without updates (sorry!) here's a new version with:
[list]
[*]Improved visuals: Now the game fields are real 3D models which gives a better depth perception. 
[*]Now you can choose AI difficulty: Easy, normal, hard
[*]Enable/disable screen shake
[*]Enable/disable gamepad vibration
[*]Enable/disable screen bloom
[*]Improved gameplay for Volleytron and Pittron
[*]Changes "under the hood" that will allow to remap keyboard controls on a future update.
[*]Bugs fixes (no more "getting into the wall under certain conditions")
[/list]
I hope you enjoy the new look and improved gameplay (the new AI is better at being good... and not so good)

Thanks for playing!

notes.title: Beta available!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

If you want to get an early look at the incoming update, please feel free to sign into the beta using the password "soccertronbeta".

If you are unsure how to do this, here's a fast HOWTO:
[list]
[*] Right-click on the game's name on your Steam's game library and select [i]Properties[/i]
[*] Go to the [b]Betas[/b] tab.
[*] Enter [b]soccertronbeta[/b] on the textbox.
[*] Click "Check code"
[*] A message will confirm that you unlocked the beta
[*] Select the new Beta option from the dropdown.
[/list]

After that, Steam will start downloading the beta version and you'll be able to give it a try!

Please report any problem or bugs you may find on the  [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/334620/discussions/]discussion forum[/url]

There'll be a proper changelog when the update is released, but a here's a glance:
[list]
[*] Improved visuals (I think you'll like it!)
[*] Options for enable/disable screen shaking, gamepad vibration and bloom effect
[*] Bug fixes: No more "entering on the goal in very rare circunstances"
[*] Improved gameplay for Volleytron and Pittron.
[/list]

Those are the most important changes, I hope you like the pre-update!

Enjoy!

A new update is live, featuring a full UI rework. After receiving a good amount of feedback, the game interface got a new look, clearer and in line with the rest of the game.

I hope you like it, what do you think?

notes.title: Dynamic backgrounds and stats
notes.notes:
The first update is out! Those old static backgrounds were pretty boring so I added old-style pixelated backgrounds similar to those on the 90's arcade machines.

Also, that ugly pause/game over dialog has been replaced by a nice stats screen. A nice way to compare your abilities against your friends!

Let me know what you think of the update!
